note: Frame-vs-interior evidence decomposition is the single most informative cheap probe of what glass models learned; run jointly with 0112's hallucination corollary as one paper.

Correspondence-density difficulty law is plausible and cheap to fit; mirror-detection architectures already exploit correspondence explicitly, so the finding may confirm the field's intuition rather than surprise it.
Warp-field pretext has roots in refractive-flow work (fluid wiggles, Schlieren-adjacent); the cross-category transfer measurement is the unclaimed part. Textureless blind spot honestly bounded.

Deterministic physics test vs learned models is satisfying, but reflection-layer motion analysis is mature; as a standalone classifier paper it is thin - better as ammunition inside the sensing-vs-modeling argument.

Polarization-cue glass segmentation with a dedicated RGB-P dataset is published at CVPR level (PGSNet line); the marginal-value-vs-architectural-progress accounting is rhetoric on top of a known result.

'Transparency is outside SAM's object ontology' as a categorical claim is a strong, cheap probe with prompt-engineering ladders as the built-in rebuttal test; transmission/reflection stratification keeps it honest.

Sensor-weakness-as-data-engine at fleet scale is the constructive flagship of C05; individual depth-invalidity cues are published, so the scaling claim and filtering recipe must carry it. Lit-attacked below.
Convention forensics with a free transfer-recovery payoff; solid but reads as a strong section of a benchmark-reform paper rather than standalone.
Rank inversion across the clarity axis would genuinely change how transparency leaderboards are read; hinges on clarity estimation without optics GT, which the calibration subset only partly fixes.
Physics-forced diurnal class flip inside a fixed scene, with annotate-once economics and a control-surface design; among the most elegant experimental setups in the batch.
Information-theoretically-invisible glass regions polluting benchmarks is a claim that, if true, invalidates a slice of every published score; small human study is the entire cost.
The open-frame hallucination corollary is the best single figure of the frame-reliance story; as a separate idea from 0101 it double-counts - merge and keep once.
Quantified antagonism between two preprocessing choices is a 3x3 ablation table; useful engineering note, not a research bet.
The driving-fleet instantiation of 0107; precision-of-mined-labels audit is the gating experiment. Merge into 0107 as its at-scale leg rather than keeping separately.

Meniscus-as-refraction-discontinuity is a charming task with robotics/lab-automation buyers; requires building the container-ladder dataset from scratch, and prior robotic liquid-perception work needs checking.
Fun diagnostic, honestly self-described as a niche probe; zero-representation-of-reflection is better established via 0121's safety-relevant version.
Caustics as transparent-object shadows is the kind of physics-first idea nobody else will try; directional-lighting operating envelope honestly narrows scope. Protect as HRHR.
'Method deltas fall inside the refractive-edge annotation noise band' is a statistically decisive kill-shot on boundary-level transparency rankings; a funded annotation study is the whole bill.
Setting-vs-category attribution matters for the next dataset's design; post-hoc descriptor regression is weak causal ground and the controlled-recapture leg is expensive.
RGB-thermal glass segmentation with paired datasets is published (RGB-T glass detection line); the economic-accounting framing does not survive the existence of the dataset papers.

Geometrically-verified phantom objects in puddles is a hidden, safety-relevant, metric-invisible error class with a built-in verification method (mirror symmetry about the road plane); best forensic idea in C05.
Shadow-luminance alpha inversion is inventive physics; multi-source lighting and interreflection corruption (own note) restrict it to strong-sun regimes, and the calibrated validation is lab-heavy.

Display-rejection via rolling-shutter banding is clever and cheap; the sensor-display compatibility matrix (own note) may show the tell vanishing exactly on modern hardware, dating the method on arrival.

'Benchmarks oversample dirty, easy glass' is a sharp distribution-shift claim against building-stock reality; contamination scoring subjectivity is the soft underbelly, partly fixed by the controlled facade capture.
Construction-era stratification is a clever confound hunt, but era entangles frames, cleanliness, and context (own note); the multi-covariate story is too soft to headline.
